Wake Up Smoothie
By: Sophie32
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:39pm

Ingredients




2 bananas, peeled & sliced
1 inch pomegranate, cut  two, the 2 halves juiced & out of 1 halve, the red pits. Do not use the white parts in
400 gr. Soy yoghurt or a yoghurt to your taste

Preparation

1 Place everything together in a bowl or blender. 2 Mix everything beautifully together. 3 Pour in glasses & enjoy!

About


I made this with leftover pomegranate & bananas
